answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils by tracing funding-source diversity: every identity must show it was funded through a distinct payment rail, like a wanderer who can only drink from one oasis at a time. A farm reusing a single exchange account to bankroll ten thousand clones leaves one marble trail linking them all, so the whole ring collapses to a single funder. Honest agents each arrive through their own funding path and pay nothing extra.
